full_judgment: 3. The respondent contested the suit by filing a written statement asserting inter alia that Kali Mohon Sen Gupta was the original owner of the suit pond, who left this country during the riot in 1947 and he never returned back. Under such circumstances, the suit pond vested in the Government as khas lands and accordingly it was recorded in M.R.R. khatian No. 1 in accordance with law. The plaintiff has no right, title, and interest in the suit property. The alleged deed of gift is forged and fraudulent one, and it has not been acted upon. The suit was instituted with a view to grab the Government's khas land which is liable to be dismissed.
